meta.title: Custom end-time duration in Minutes, Hours or Days
gaps: Verify that the saved end time equals the start time plus the entered duration for each unit.
The exact labels of the custom duration value and unit controls are not confirmed by the catalog.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the saved end time equals the start time plus the entered duration for each unit.; The exact labels of the custom duration value and unit controls are not confirmed by the catalog.

steps.note: Open an eRFX create screen containing the Schedule panel.
Provide the mandatory event title for a create flow.
Apply a pricing template so the event can be configured.
Add the required line item to enable schedule configuration.
Complete the pricing sheet before opening the schedule.
Open the Schedule side panel.
Choose custom duration rather than a preset.
Enter a numeric custom duration for the Minutes case.
Set the custom duration unit to Minutes.
Save the Minutes duration.
Confirm the saved schedule displays its duration summary.
Reopen the schedule to test another custom unit.
Choose custom duration for the Hours case.
Enter a numeric custom duration for the Hours case.
Set the custom duration unit to Hours.
Save the Hours duration.
Confirm the saved schedule displays its duration summary.
Reopen the schedule to test the Days unit.
Choose custom duration for the Days case.
Enter a numeric custom duration for the Days case.
Set the custom duration unit to Days.
Save the Days duration.
Confirm the saved schedule displays its duration summary.
